how_to_apply: Download the application form from www.drdo.gov.in.
Fill up the form by typing only – handwritten forms will be rejected.

Enter Name, Apprentice Category, Discipline/Branch, NATS Enrollment No., Aadhaar No., Father's Name, Nationality, Date of Birth, Gender, Reservation Category, contact details, addresses, and educational qualification details (10th, 12th, Diploma, B.Tech as applicable) with marks/percentage.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph and sign the declaration.
Attach mark sheets of the essential qualification and reservation certificate (if applicable) as enclosures.

Send the completed form by Speed Post/Registered Post only to: The Director, Proof & Experimental Establishment (PXE), Defence R&D Organisation, PO- Chandipur, Dist- Balasore, Odisha- 756025 (Kind Attn. OIC, HRDC).
Clearly mention on the envelope: "Application for Engagement of Apprentices, Apprentice Category (Degree/Diploma) and Discipline/Branch….."
Ensure the application reaches PXE on or before 12 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: PXE Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: 15 Graduate Apprentice (B.Tech) 35 Technician Apprentice (Diploma) 50 Total Vacancies Note: PXE reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies for apprenticeship engagement at its discretion.

content_sections.heading: PXE Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: B.Tech (in the discipline applied for) for Graduate Apprentice, or a Diploma (in the discipline applied for) for Technician Apprentice – see the discipline-wise tables above. Candidates must register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal (nats.education.gov.in); applications from non-registered candidates or with an invalid Enrollment No. will be rejected Only candidates who passed their respective course in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 are eligible Candidates holding a post-graduation degree will not be considered and need not apply Only candidates who completed the essential qualification through regular mode are eligible Candidates with one year or more of training/job experience after acquiring the essential qualification will not be considered Reservation (SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS) is applied as per the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, as amended; caste/category certificates must be produced at document verification

content_sections.heading: PXE Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Stipend
content_sections.text: The engagement is for a one-year Apprenticeship Training only and does not confer any right to regular employment in PXE or DRDO. Apprentices are not provided accommodation or transport during training.

content_sections.heading: PXE Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Selection Board of PXE screens applications and shortlists candidates based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential qualification Shortlisted candidates are called for a Written Test/Interview , held at PXE, Chandipur Selected candidates are offered a joining letter through e-mail only All correspondence, including the offer letter, is sent by e-mail only – candidates are responsible for downloading and printing it; PXE is not responsible for loss due to an invalid/wrong e-mail ID or delivery to spam/bulk folders Not specified in the official notification: the written test syllabus, pattern, marks weightage, or interview schedule.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PXE Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from www.drdo.gov.in . Fill up the form by typing only – handwritten forms will be rejected. Enter Name, Apprentice Category, Discipline/Branch, NATS Enrollment No., Aadhaar No., Father's Name, Nationality, Date of Birth, Gender, Reservation Category, contact details, addresses, and educational qualification details (10th, 12th, Diploma, B.Tech as applicable) with marks/percentage. Affix a recent passport-size photograph and sign the declaration. Attach mark sheets of the essential qualification and reservation certificate (if applicable) as enclosures. Send the completed form by Speed Post/Registered Post only to: The Director, Proof & Experimental Establishment (PXE), Defence R&D Organisation, PO- Chandipur, Dist- Balasore, Odisha- 756025 (Kind Attn. OIC, HRDC) . Clearly mention on the envelope: "Application for Engagement of Apprentices, Apprentice Category (Degree/Diploma) and Discipline/Branch….." Ensure the application reaches PXE on or before 12 October 2026 . Important: There is no online application portal or e-mail submission route for this recruitment. Handwritten or incomplete application forms will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Mark sheets of the essential qualification (HSC/10th, 12th, Diploma, B.Tech, as applicable) NATS Enrollment Number/proof of registration Aadhaar card Reservation/caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS), if applicable, issued by the competent authority Recent passport-size photograph (affixed to the form)

faq.question: Q1. How many apprentice vacancies are notified by PXE Chandipur?
faq.answer: 50 vacancies – 15 Graduate Apprentice (B.Tech) and 35 Technician Apprentice (Diploma), across disciplines like Electronics & Communication, Mechanical, Computer Science, Chemical, Civil, Electrical, Cinematography, and Automobile.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach PXE, Chandipur by post on or before 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply online?
faq.answer: No. There is no online application portal; the form must be downloaded, filled by typing only, and sent by Speed Post/Registered Post.

faq.question: Q4. Is NATS registration mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal; applications without a valid Enrollment No. will be rejected.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for PXE apprentices?
faq.answer: ₹12,300 per month for Graduate Apprentice (B.Tech) and ₹10,900 per month for Technician Apprentice (Diploma).

faq.question: Q6. Who is not eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates with a post-graduation degree, those who passed outside 2022–2026, non-regular-mode qualification holders, and those with one year or more of post-qualification training/job experience are not eligible.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on percentage of marks in the essential qualification, followed by a Written Test/Interview at PXE, Chandipur.

faq.question: Q8. Does this apprenticeship guarantee a job at DRDO?
faq.answer: No. The offer of Apprenticeship Training does not confer any right to employment in PXE or DRDO.
